query_model_natural_language_to_logical_: query the NLU model with a natural language chat string to get its parsed logical form tree
eval_model_accuracy: evaluate the NLU model on a dataset and log accuracy, text span accuracy, and inference speed
model_configure_load_pretrained: configure and load a pretrained encoder-decoder NLU model with its tokenizer from a model directory
dataset_configure_caip: configure a CAIP test dataset using the pretrained tokenizer and model arguments
build_grammar_from_data: build a full grammar tree and vocabulary from annotated data files and save to JSON
